import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import time
import uuid

sys.path.insert(0, '/home/r/dev/minor/stackd/scripts/aws')
from aws_cli import observe

env = dict(os.environ, AWS_REGION='us-west-2', AWS_DEFAULT_REGION='us-west-2', AWS_PAGER='', AWS_MAX_ATTEMPTS='1')
for key in list(env):
    if key.startswith('AWS_ENDPOINT_URL'):
        del env[key]
prefix = 'stackd-secret-lifecycle-' + uuid.uuid4().hex[:10]
path = Path('/home/r/dev/minor/stackd/testdata/aws/secretsmanager/lifecycle.json')
path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
result = {'account': '000000000000', 'region': 'us-west-2', 'prefix': prefix, 'observations': [], 'source': Path(__file__).read_text(), 'value_provenance': 'All secret values and policies belong to this probe; no existing account secret values are read.'}
versions = [str(uuid.uuid4()) for _ in range(5)]
owned = False

def call(label, operation, payload):
    started = int(time.time() * 1000)
    response = observe('secretsmanager', operation, payload, env, paginate=False)
    result['observations'].append({'label': label, 'service': 'secretsmanager', 'operation': operation, 'input': payload, 'request_started_ms': started, 'request_finished_ms': int(time.time() * 1000), 'result': response})
    path.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')
    print(label, response['code'], flush=True)
    return response

def success(response):
    if response['code'] != 'Success':
        raise RuntimeError(response)
    return response['output']

try:
    owned = True
    created = success(call('create-empty', 'create-secret', {'Name': prefix, 'Description': 'owned lifecycle evidence'}))
    arn = created['ARN']
    call('describe-empty', 'describe-secret', {'SecretId': arn})
    call('get-empty', 'get-secret-value', {'SecretId': arn})
    call('cancel-unconfigured-rotation', 'cancel-rotate-secret', {'SecretId': arn})
    call('rotate-without-function', 'rotate-secret', {'SecretId': arn})
    success(call('put-first', 'put-secret-value', {'SecretId': arn, 'ClientRequestToken': versions[0], 'SecretString': 'owned-first-value'}))
    call('put-identical-token-with-label', 'put-secret-value', {'SecretId': arn, 'ClientRequestToken': versions[0], 'SecretString': 'owned-first-value', 'VersionStages': ['REPLAY']})
    call('put-conflicting-token', 'put-secret-value', {'SecretId': arn, 'ClientRequestToken': versions[0], 'SecretString': 'owned-different-value'})
    call('describe-first', 'describe-secret', {'SecretId': arn})
    success(call('put-labeled-binary', 'put-secret-value', {'SecretId': arn, 'ClientRequestToken': versions[1], 'SecretBinary': 'YWJjAAE=', 'VersionStages': ['BLUE']}))
    call('get-current-before-move', 'get-secret-value', {'SecretId': arn})
    call('get-binary-by-version', 'get-secret-value', {'SecretId': arn, 'VersionId': versions[1]})
    call('get-mismatched-version-stage', 'get-secret-value', {'SecretId': arn, 'VersionId': versions[1], 'VersionStage': 'AWSCURRENT'})
    success(call('put-next-current', 'put-secret-value', {'SecretId': arn, 'ClientRequestToken': versions[2], 'SecretString': 'owned-third-value'}))
    call('describe-next-current', 'describe-secret', {'SecretId': arn})
    call('list-versions', 'list-secret-version-ids', {'SecretId': arn, 'IncludeDeprecated': True})
    success(call('move-current-to-binary', 'update-secret-version-stage', {'SecretId': arn, 'VersionStage': 'AWSCURRENT', 'MoveToVersionId': versions[1], 'RemoveFromVersionId': versions[2]}))
    call('get-current-binary', 'get-secret-value', {'SecretId': arn})
    call('get-previous', 'get-secret-value', {'SecretId': arn, 'VersionStage': 'AWSPREVIOUS'})
    call('move-current-without-owner', 'update-secret-version-stage', {'SecretId': arn, 'VersionStage': 'AWSCURRENT', 'MoveToVersionId': versions[0]})
    success(call('move-custom-label', 'update-secret-version-stage', {'SecretId': arn, 'VersionStage': 'BLUE', 'MoveToVersionId': versions[2], 'RemoveFromVersionId': versions[1]}))
    call('list-live-versions', 'list-secret-version-ids', {'SecretId': arn})
    call('list-all-versions', 'list-secret-version-ids', {'SecretId': arn, 'IncludeDeprecated': True})
    call('batch-values-and-missing', 'batch-get-secret-value', {'SecretIdList': [arn, prefix + '-missing']})
    success(call('update-description', 'update-secret', {'SecretId': arn, 'Description': 'changed without a version'}))
    call('describe-description-change', 'describe-secret', {'SecretId': arn})
    success(call('update-value', 'update-secret', {'SecretId': arn, 'ClientRequestToken': versions[3], 'SecretString': 'owned-fourth-value'}))
    call('get-updated-value', 'get-secret-value', {'SecretId': arn})
    success(call('tag', 'tag-resource', {'SecretId': arn, 'Tags': [{'Key': 'purpose', 'Value': 'connection-prerequisite'}]}))
    call('describe-tagged', 'describe-secret', {'SecretId': arn})
    success(call('untag', 'untag-resource', {'SecretId': arn, 'TagKeys': ['purpose']}))
    call('describe-untagged', 'describe-secret', {'SecretId': arn})
    call('random-password', 'get-random-password', {'PasswordLength': 14, 'ExcludePunctuation': True, 'RequireEachIncludedType': True})
    private = {'Version': '2012-10-17', 'Statement': [{'Effect': 'Allow', 'Principal': {'AWS': 'arn:aws:iam::000000000000:root'}, 'Action': 'secretsmanager:GetSecretValue', 'Resource': '*'}]}
    public = {'Version': '2012-10-17', 'Statement': [{'Effect': 'Allow', 'Principal': '*', 'Action': 'secretsmanager:GetSecretValue', 'Resource': '*'}]}
    call('validate-private-policy', 'validate-resource-policy', {'SecretId': arn, 'ResourcePolicy': json.dumps(private)})
    call('validate-public-policy', 'validate-resource-policy', {'SecretId': arn, 'ResourcePolicy': json.dumps(public)})
    call('reject-public-policy', 'put-resource-policy', {'SecretId': arn, 'ResourcePolicy': json.dumps(public), 'BlockPublicPolicy': True})
    success(call('put-private-policy', 'put-resource-policy', {'SecretId': arn, 'ResourcePolicy': json.dumps(private), 'BlockPublicPolicy': True}))
    call('get-private-policy', 'get-resource-policy', {'SecretId': arn})
    success(call('delete-policy', 'delete-resource-policy', {'SecretId': arn}))
    call('get-absent-policy', 'get-resource-policy', {'SecretId': arn})
    call('list-owned', 'list-secrets', {'Filters': [{'Key': 'name', 'Values': [prefix]}]})
    success(call('schedule-deletion', 'delete-secret', {'SecretId': arn, 'RecoveryWindowInDays': 7}))
    call('describe-scheduled', 'describe-secret', {'SecretId': arn})
    call('get-scheduled', 'get-secret-value', {'SecretId': arn})
    call('put-scheduled', 'put-secret-value', {'SecretId': arn, 'ClientRequestToken': versions[4], 'SecretString': 'owned-blocked-value'})
    call('list-planned-deletion', 'list-secrets', {'Filters': [{'Key': 'name', 'Values': [prefix]}], 'IncludePlannedDeletion': True})
    success(call('restore', 'restore-secret', {'SecretId': arn}))
    call('describe-restored', 'describe-secret', {'SecretId': arn})
    call('get-restored', 'get-secret-value', {'SecretId': arn})
finally:
    if owned:
        call('cleanup-delete', 'delete-secret', {'SecretId': prefix, 'ForceDeleteWithoutRecovery': True})
        for attempt in range(90):
            absent = call('cleanup-absence-' + str(attempt), 'describe-secret', {'SecretId': prefix})
            if absent['code'] == 'ResourceNotFoundException':
                result['cleanup'] = 'independently absent'
                break
            time.sleep(2)
        else:
            result['cleanup'] = 'deletion requested; absence not yet observed'
        path.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')
